definitions.explanation: The board used to play the game of go ({囲碁|いご}), marked with a grid of lines on which stones are placed at the intersections.

examples.japanese: {囲碁盤|いごばん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{出|だ}す→出す：01087_dasu⟧。
{囲碁盤|いごばん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{上|うえ}→上：00682_ue⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{石|いし}→石：02177_ishi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{並|なら}べる→並べる：01091_naraberu⟧。
examples.english: Arrange the stones on the go board.

examples.japanese: ⟦{祖父|そふ}→祖父：01452_sofu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{木|き}→木：00524_ki⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦できた→できる：00557_dekiru⟧⟦{立派|りっぱ}→立派：01093_rippa⟧な{囲碁盤|いごばん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{持|も}っている→持つ：00478_motsu⟧。
examples.english: My grandfather has a splendid go board made of wood.

notes:
Also called simply ⟦{碁盤|ごばん}→碁盤：13716_goban⟧. The standard board has a 19-by-19 grid of intersecting lines.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {囲碁盤|いごばん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{囲|かこ}む→囲む：02037_kakomu⟧: to sit around a go board
- {囲碁盤|いごばん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{目|め}→目：00525_me⟧: the grid intersections of a go board

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{碁盤|ごばん}→碁盤：13716_goban⟧: go board — the shorter, more common word; ⟦{碁盤|ごばん}→碁盤：13716_goban⟧⟦{目|め}→目：00525_me⟧ also means a grid pattern
- ⟦{将棋盤|しょうぎばん}→将棋盤：24835_shougiban⟧: shogi board — for Japanese chess
